item.title: TSTC Abilene launches course for data center careers
item.description: ABILENE, Texas (KTAB/KRBC) – Texas State Technical College (TSTC) in Abilene is now offering specialized training for data center operators. The new 224-hour course covers electrical systems, mechanical fundamentals, fiber optics, OSHA 10 certification, HVAC and leadership skills.
